items.headline: Amazon Pharmacy Reports Significant Growth in Customers and Delivery Reach

items.summary: William Blair downgraded Broadcom from Outperform to Market Perform, citing valuation concerns as the stock trades at over 40 times earnings.

items.summary: Microsoft is reportedly planning to raise approximately $25 billion through its first U.S. investment-grade bond sale in over nine years.

items.summary: Blackstone is warning investors that Anthropic may struggle to secure an investment-grade credit rating following its IPO.

items.summary: Alphabet logs its worst week since 2011 and Intel its worst day ever as the AI trade cracks, while health care posts a record month against the market.

items.headline: Meta Reaches Settlement in Social Media Addiction Trial
items.summary: Meta has settled with plaintiffs in a social media addiction case that was scheduled for trial in Los Angeles.

items.headline: Amazon Discloses Prime Video Profitability and Revenue Scale
items.summary: CEO Andy Jassy announced that Prime Video has become a profitable business generating annualized revenue in the tens of billions of dollars.

items.headline: NVIDIA Customer AM Intelligence Seeks $3 Billion Financing for Processor Order
items.summary: Indian AI infrastructure firm AM Intelligence is reportedly seeking up to $3 billion in capital to fund a previously announced order of NVIDIA's next-generation processors.

items.headline: Why Is IREN Stock Falling on Friday?

items.headline: Why Is Nebius Stock Falling on Friday?
items.summary: Nebius Group NV (NASDAQ: NBIS) stock falls Friday as earnings reports from Amazon and Intel raises questions about cloud and AI infrastructure spending.

items.headline: US Customs Releases TOYO Solar Shipments from Ethiopia
